title: Zesty Sweet Australian Toor Dal Onigiri
description: A sweet and dense Australian dish featuring toor dal, shaped into nigiri, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Rinse the toor dal and cook it in 2 cups of water until it is tender.
Mash the cooked toor dal and set it aside to cool.
Mix the cooled toor dal with cooked brown rice, honey, lemon juice, and salt.
Knead the mixture until it forms a sticky dough.
Divide the dough into small portions and shape each portion into a triangle.
Brush the tops of the triangles with sesame oil.
Serve the onigiri at room temperature or store them in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.
Let the onigiri come to room temperature before serving if refrigerated.
